title: Hidden achievements: one file per package (core/achievements.gd, docs/story/eggs.md)

id.description: The package's id; the file is data/achievements/<id>.json.
Unique across the achievements in Achievements.LIST, every file here and the endings' ending_<id>.

name.description: Shown once earned; the panel's row reads "A secret" until then.

text.description: How it is earned, shown once it has been.

hidden.description: True (the default): the panel shows "A secret" until it is earned.

when.description: A story condition (docs/contracts/dialogue.md) that earns it the moment it holds, checked whenever the party's state may have changed. Without one, the game earns it in code (Achievements.for_*).
